title: Buah Mentah Bikin Satu Muatan Kena Potong
hook: Tandan mentah yang ikut naik ke mobil bukan cuma satu tandan rugi karena hitungan sortasi bisa menyeret seluruh muatan.
story: Pak Vincent berdiri di tepi poros kebun tanah merah sore hari. Sejak detik 0.0s tangan kanannya sudah memegang satu tandan buah sawit hijau gelap yang brondolannya masih rapat, dan telunjuk kiri mengetuk permukaan tandan itu. Ia bicara lugas bahwa tandan macam ini kalau ikut naik ke mobil bisa bikin muatan kena potong. Ia memutar tandan sedikit, memperlihatkan brondolan yang belum lepas, lalu bilang patokannya brondolan lepas dan kalau belum lepas biarkan dulu di pokok. Di detik terakhir ia menatap lensa dengan senyum bersahaja sambil tetap memegang tandan dan bertanya kawan-kawan biasa pakai dodos atau egrek. Situasi harian di kebun, bukan kejadian baru dalam canon.
caption:
Buah mentah yang ikut naik ke mobil bukan cuma satu tandan yang rugi karena hitungan sortasi bisa ikut menyeret seluruh muatan. Patokannya sederhana, tunggu brondolan lepas dulu baru dipanen. Kawan-kawan di kebun lebih percaya dodos atau egrek buat jaga buah tetap bersih?

shots.prompt: Authentic handheld smartphone vlog video of Pak Vincent the exact same Indonesian man shown in the two attached reference photos (three-expression sheet and full-body turnaround). Output exactly ONE man in ONE continuous shot, never a collage, split screen or reference-sheet layout. Vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, medium shot waist-up at eye level with very slight natural handheld sway. Location: the edge of a red-brown dirt plantation road in Riau beside his smallholding, a few oil palm trunks and dry frond pieces softly out of focus behind him under soft overcast late-afternoon daylight, no vehicles and no other people in focus. He wears the vintage royal blue Samsung football jersey, dark shorts, dark baseball cap and rubber work sandals, lean wiry sun-tanned build, weathered skin with fine pores, thin mustache, calm modest expression. PROP CONTINUITY: from 0.0s until the final frame his right hand already holds one single dark green unripe oil palm fruit bunch with tightly packed spikelets and no loose fruit, held at chest height and staying clearly visible in frame the whole time with nothing appearing or disappearing mid-take; his left hand only taps and points at that same bunch and never picks up another object, no machete, no sickle, no basket and no second bunch entering the shot. At 0.0s his left index finger is already tapping the top of the bunch. He speaks in natural friendly Indonesian with a warm Riau tone in three short sentences: he says a bunch like this one, if it rides along to the mill, can drag the whole load into a sorting cut; he rotates the bunch slightly to show the spikelets still tightly packed and says the sign is loose fruit, so if none has come loose yet, leave it on the tree; then he looks straight into the lens with a modest smile and a small nod and asks whether the folks out there use a dodos or an egrek to keep the fruit clean. Around the tenth second his left hand drops beside the bunch while the bunch stays in the right hand until the last frame. Shot on a smartphone vlog camera, natural clean daylight, neutral white balance 5500K, true-to-life colors, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores, no plastic shine, no waxy skin, no glass skin, no yellow or orange tint, no artificial golden glow, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary look. Clean frame with no baked-in text, no subtitles, no camera information bar, no fps or color-temperature readout, no location label, no timestamps, no watermark, no logo.

trend_sources.title: Potongan sortasi TBS sawit capai tujuh persen, Apkasindo Dharmasraya minta pabrik tinjau ulang (ANTARA Sumbar)
trend_sources.evidence: Apkasindo menyebut potongan sortasi TBS di salah satu pabrik mencapai tujuh persen padahal ketentuan Permentan 1,5 sampai lima persen, dan objek sortirnya antara lain buah muda, tangkai panjang serta janjang kosong. Dipakai sebagai konteks bahwa buah muda yang ikut terpanen berhubungan langsung dengan potongan berat yang diterima pekebun.

trend_sources.title: BN 217-2013 ketentuan mutu panen TBS (salinan Permentan tentang pedoman budidaya kelapa sawit)
trend_sources.evidence: Ketentuan mutu panen menyebut tandan boleh dipotong bila sudah ada satu brondolan lepas per kg TBS, gagang panjang di atas 2,5 cm ikut dinilai, dan buah mentah gabungan fraksi 00 dan 0 didenda 50 persen dikali persentase buah mentah dikali berat TBS yang diterima.

trend_sources.title: Analisis Risiko Panen Tandan Buah Segar Kelapa Sawit (Jurnal AGRICA, Universitas Medan Area)
trend_sources.evidence: Kajian risiko panen menyebut alat panen egrek dan dodos dipakai untuk memotong TBS dan bahwa pemanenan buah mentah masih sering terjadi, sehingga pilihan alat serta ketelitian pemanen berpengaruh pada mutu buah yang dikirim.

source_note: Video tidak menyebut angka persen atau rupiah apa pun. Sumber hanya dipakai sebagai konteks brief: objek sortir di RAM atau PKS mencakup buah muda dan tangkai panjang (ANTARA Sumbar), patokan matang panen satu brondolan lepas per kg TBS serta denda buah mentah (BN 217-2013), dan penggunaan dodos maupun egrek saat panen (Jurnal AGRICA UMA).
